annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its title promotes Forsage as an earning platform and provides a contact number, while the footage displays claimed BUSD earnings together with partner, team and matrix figures. The U.S. SEC charged Forsage operators and promoters over an alleged crypto pyramid scheme in which earnings depended on recruitment; that allegation is project-level context, not a claim that this uploader was charged or that the sparse video alone proves the whole scheme.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits the advertised network-marketing income and visible partner/team/matrix dashboard. The video supports the promotional connection; the SEC's complaint supplies qualified external context about the alleged recruitment-based scheme.
